training_split.method: chronological 70/30 split of distinct baseline timestamps, per service

label_assumptions.assumed_normal_baseline: Chronological baseline evaluation rows are assumed normal; labels are not independently reviewed.
label_assumptions.synthetic_controls: Generated bounded-noise controls are assumed normal.
label_assumptions.synthetic_positives: Injected point and episode anomalies are labeled positive by construction, not by independent operational review.

environment.code_revision_scope: HEAD only; does not identify uncommitted working-tree changes

configuration.name: unscaled_control
configuration.fit_scope: separate per service on the same 42-row training split

configuration.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on training rows per service
configuration.fit_scope: separate per service on the same 42-row training split

configuration.fit_scope: separate per service on the same 42-row training split

configuration.name: unscaled_contamination_0.10
configuration.fit_scope: separate per service on the same 42-row training split

interpretation_limits: All positive labels are synthetic and normal labels are assumed; none are independently verified operational labels.
All variants are exploratory diagnostics on the same frozen fixture; results are not unbiased performance estimates.
No variant is selected or recommended from these held-out labels.
Standardization is a diagnostic-only change to preprocessing, not a runtime proposal.
Contamination variants change the model decision threshold behavior and are diagnostics, not threshold tuning.
Unscaled Isolation Forest decision_function values are joint-model scores, not feature-attributed scores.
Integrity hashes detect accidental or uncoordinated changes but do not authenticate authorship or prove detector execution.

integrity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and no NaN; digest covers the complete report except the integrity object
